page.overview:
Who is Osmo Kyllonen?

Osmo Kyllonen was a representative of the Spacing Guild.

Kyllonen was approached by the Prisoner in the CHOAM Exchange in Harko Village. When asked if she was a Guild Navigator, she replied that she was merely a servant of the administration who was there to acquire Spice Melange from the resourceful, determined and rude. She also told them of Glossu Rabban's degeneracy and stated that she had no fear of speaking in such a way, as Rabban took pride in his proclivities.
